full_page.content:
1951, April 22 December 18
The following is a faithful transcription of photo copies of the Seraphic Mass Association Certificate and Remembrance by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Ven. Sister Mary Leoncia O.S.F. for special Intent., God willing and for His holy guidance -
emergency special April 22, 1951
"And the Lord said to me: My grace is sufficient for thee ".
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Courage! Confidence in God (abstinance from delicasces.)
Christmas - forpatient progress in virtue - Ven. Sister Mary Leoncia. . ..
Why not offer our temptations themselves to God - for perseverance in purity, etc of inexperience, youth, etc .... fostering confidence in God, the very soul of prayer. Bles'd be God in all His designs.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Dec. 18 - 1956
Originals in possession of: Sister Leoncia Madonna College 36600 Schoolcraft Rd. Livonia, MI. 48150
